<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def gb(fr):
    out={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N' and n['pixels']!=7 and n['pixels']>1:
            cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]; out['g']=(min(cs),max(cs))
        if n['color']=='Y' and n['pixels']!=7 and n['pixels']>1:
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; out['y']=(min(rs),max(rs))
    return out
# grow green repeatedly, record length each time
for k in range(6):
    r=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':21,'col':45}])
    g=gb(current_frame)
    print("grow",k,"green",g,"score",r.get('score'),"state",r.get('state'))
    if r.get('level_completed') or r.get('done'): break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
